course_name_original: Design and development of automation equipment
course_name_en: Design and development of automation equipment
prerequisites: knowledge from specific courses in technology and manufacturing design

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to design independently simple devices for automation.
Preparedness to participate in the development of complex machines and systems of machines for automated manufacturing in diploma projects and engineering practice.

syllabus_topics: Basic principles and consequences in the project design
Design of mechanisms for supporting motions
Automation equipment in serial and mass production
The place of man in the automated systems of manufacturing equipment
assessment_rules: Constant control is provided by means of control questions or entrance tests at the beginning of each class. At the end of the study term a written exam is carried out. A numerical system for students’ overall knowledge estimation is developed. The final mark is formed after a discussion with the student.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
